answer: String: Use a shared deposit clearinghouse: every new agent identity must lock 12 credits for 30 days, refunded only after clean activity. Honest agents keep that fee because one established identity earns more than a clone can gain from a fresh start. A cloned identity is a separate island with no history, so it must pay the same 12 credits again and cannot borrow the original's marble reputation. The clearinghouse also records a velvet-smooth audit trail, making duplicate behavior visible before refunds clear.
